title: Relevance and Coordinate Dependence
statement: Let $f:\\{−1,1\\}^n\\to\\mathbb R$ and let $i$ be a coordinate. The influence of $f$ at $i$ is positive if and only if there is a sign-cube point $x$ such that the values of $f$ with coordinate $i$ set to $1$ and to $-1$ differ.
